Preparation reuses output and extracted directories; prior partial GML/XML files remain discoverable by recursive matcher scans.
Seed zip_name is joined directly to authority_dir after only URL suffix comparison; absolute or parent segments are not rejected.
Matcher accepts feature.id and generic id-like properties without binding the official INSPIRE identifier field/schema.
Invalid geometry is silently passed through make_valid without original/repaired topology, component or area-delta limits.
Verifier checks manifest slot_id but not task_id, attempt_id, continuation_key, final_ready or fake_data.
A valid target example can pass while conflicting duplicates are ignored and the final matching record overwrites earlier matches.
Verifier omits candidate extractor, HMLR preparation, HMLR matcher and EA sampler from EXPECTED pins; EA sampler is not blob-pinned.
Verifier treats string-token presence as control-flow proof, so comments or dead code can satisfy checks.
